hooks.name: tape-format-guard
hooks.description: The tape format is the contract between every component. Guard it.

action.prompt: The tape format in crates/necro-tape just changed. 1) Check every consumer crate (seance-proxy, crypt, sarcophagus, necro-server, necro-mcp) still compiles against it. 2) Make sure the proptest round-trip property decode(encode(tape)) == tape covers any new field. 3) Summarize the change in one line.
